ValidationRule.description: Require competitors lease expiration date > Today
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Validation_Rules__c && NOT($Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Executing__c) && ( $RecordType.Name = "Equipment Deals" || $RecordType.Name = "MPS Deal" ) &&( ISBLANK( TSGADX__Competitor_Lease_Expiration_Date__c ) || TSGADX__Competitor_Lease_Expiration_Date__c <= Today() +360) && ISPICKVAL(TSGADX__Sales_Stage__c, "Lost to Competition")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter the competitors lease expiration date and it must be greater than 1 year from today. This will automatically create a future deal with a close date of 1 year minus the competitors lease expiration date.
